items.description: CouponMoto provides coupon codes and exclusive offers to save you time and money while shopping online. The site covers a large number of stores. Coupons are updated and verified daily. The app is available on Google Play.
The Voucherify mashup allows to sell vouchers or coupons for through Shopify. Vouchers can be useful for exams, therapy sessions, and gift cards.
South America-related maps. Sophisticated map search.
DekiWiki, a popular wiki designed to help users quickly create mashups. Integrates various third party web APIs.
Information, news and satellite maps about ski resorts in Canada.
Tracks and graphs Amazon price history. Allows user to be emailed when the price hits a desired point.
A simple mashup showing interesting Flickr photos.
Online bed and breakfast directory with listings worldwide, travel gift certificates and Blog.
Streeartmap supports buskers works and gives visitors the possibility to vote every single performance, like digg.

Phone2Action is a digital grassroots platform that attracts and engages supporters from around the web. It provides political campaigns with tools such as social media, calling, and email advocacy to help connect political candidates with their supporters.
A straightforward and clean interface to YouTube via their APIs. Workplace safe.
Interactive Google Map of the Montreal subway system with links to the Montreal Transit Website.
Google Picasa image search, in Turkish language. Uses GoogleAjaxFeeds to show latest searches.
Paid service to find bank owned homes and short sales. You can search for free and find approximate locations, all displayed on a Google Map.

Like Catch Phrase, but you use your phone instead of a device, and everyone always has a word. Text play to start. You will receive the name of a famous person/character. Get others in your group to text that name to the number (without saying it yourself; text pass to skip). You can receive points either by guessing correctly or by getting guessed. The first person to a set score wins!
TravelSkoot is an itinerary planning tool. It allows travelers and locals to put together lists of destinations to create personalized itineraries called Skoots, and share them with their friends.
Profileomat is a shareable Profile Aggregator that lists all your personal Websites, Social Networks, Blogs, Contact Info, Photo Albums and other Profiles in a box. Formerly called linkmybox.com
A numerical ranking based on popularity of country music artists.
